authority: This remediation authorizes exactly one additional production behavior fix exposed by the remediation-v2 measurement-timing mutation test. It is execution-authoritative over all prior iteration-007 contracts only where it adds strict semantic validation of already-required Stage-2 timing evidence. Every replacement prepare receipt, execution spec, checkpoint metadata, execution receipt, validator, and test must bind all eight contract file hashes.

confirmed_defect.observation: A 32-record compact Stage-2 chain with valid chronological links and recomputed self-hashes still returned status=pass after the measurement_timing payloads were deliberately interchanged so that pre_step carried a post-output sentinel and post_step carried loss.
confirmed_defect.failure_mechanism: validate_compact_update_chain checked only record count, ordinals, previous-record links, record self-hashes, and optional whole-record equality. It did not validate the exact measurement_timing schema or bind nested pre-step and post-step evidence to the corresponding authoritative top-level fields.

authorized_production_fix.scope: Add one fail-closed Stage-2 compact-record schema and measurement-timing semantic validator and invoke it for every one of the 32 compact update records on every validate_compact_update_chain call, including calls without an independent reconstruction. No training or report-producer behavior change is authorized or required.
authorized_production_fix.record_hash_rule: record_hash is the canonical SHA-256 of the other exact 21 compact-record fields. Exact schema and timing semantics are validated in addition to, not instead of, this self-hash and the chronological previous-record hash chain.
authorized_production_fix.comparison_rule: The compact record and both timing mappings must have their exact key sets. Each bound nested value must have byte-identical canonical JSON encoding to its authoritative top-level value. Missing, extra, renamed, duplicate-after-decoding, wrong-type, noncanonical, or unequal evidence raises before pass can be returned. Python loose equality is insufficient.
authorized_production_fix.schema_nonextensions: value_identity and frozen_encoder_value_contract remain authoritative post-step top-level evidence but are not duplicated inside measurement_timing. Do not add them, a per-record schema_version, or any other producer field.
temporal_semantics: The authoritative top-level loss, policy_loss, anchor_kl_loss, entropy, and gradient fields continue to come from the pre-step full batch and backward pass immediately preceding that record's optimizer step.
The authoritative top-level optimizer state, parameter deltas, safety result, and output hashes continue to come from the model and optimizer after that optimizer step.
parameter_diffs_from_stage_start and its nested alias parameter_diffs_from_fixed_stage_2_start continue to use the one fixed post-Stage-1 snapshot for all Stage-2 updates 1 through 32.
The validator adds no new measurement, recomputation, rounding, tolerance, or persisted raw-row claim. It only authenticates the existing timing schema and exact duplicated evidence.
forbidden_changes: changing the Stage-2 compact report producer or the order of backward, clipping, optimizer.step, successful-step accounting, post-step measurement, safety evaluation, or receipt construction

changing any model, data, advantage, behavior log-probability, objective, coefficient, learning rate, optimizer, trainability, schedule, diagnostic milestone, safety threshold, or acceptance threshold
accepting a record merely because its self-hash or hash-chain link was recomputed after a semantic timing mutation
requiring independent_reconstruction as a prerequisite for semantic timing validation
weakening any directional-membership, artifact-allowlist, publication-identity, probability, value, optimizer, or nonfinite check
creating prepare v3, an execution spec, a checkpoint, optimizer state, or games before all required tests pass

required_fix_tests: A correctly generated 32-record chain from the production Stage-2 report path passes the new semantic validator both with and without independent_reconstruction.
Distinct pre-step and post-step sentinels travel through the production report builder and land only in their exact authorized nested keys while all top-level semantic bindings remain byte-identical.
After recomputing every affected record hash and downstream previous_record_hash, swapping the pre_step and post_step objects is rejected.
The same correctly rehashed malformed chain is rejected when it is also supplied verbatim as independent_reconstruction.

After recomputing the chain, moving or copying loss, policy loss, anchor contribution, entropy, either gradient map, optimizer steps, any parameter-delta set, safety, or either output hash to the wrong phase is rejected one field at a time.
Missing, extra, renamed, non-mapping, or wrong-type timing objects and nested fields are rejected even when the record and chain hashes are valid.
A mutation of parameter_diffs_from_fixed_stage_2_start to the preceding-update delta is rejected, and the production path proves all 32 records use the same fixed post-Stage-1 snapshot.

All remediation-v2 directional, output-confinement, artifact, and timing tests plus remediation-v3 membership tests and remediation-v4 real-filesystem publication tests remain mutation-sensitive and pass.

replacement_prepare.publication: Create exactly once with CREATE_NEW semantics only after the authorized membership, artifact-allowlist, and timing-semantic fixes, every remediation-v2/v3/v4/v5 test, and all regressions pass. Preserve prepare v1 and v2 byte-exact.

execution_spec_override.loader_key_derivation: Preserve the prior 36-key v6 set as EXECUTION_SPEC_V6_TOP_LEVEL_KEYS by excluding only the v5 path/hash pair from the new v7 set. The v4 remediation loader must compare its override against that preserved v6 set; derive all older sets transitively without changing them.

stop_rule: After the single timing-semantic validation fix and all previously authorized fixes and tests pass, generate prepare v3 exactly once and stop for independent code and numerical-provenance audits before execution-spec authoring. If any further production defect appears, do not alter production behavior without another root-authored correction.
